planets.name: LHS 475 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LHS 475 with a 2.03-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: LHS 475 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around LHS 475. Its orbit and size follow Lustig-Yaeger et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LUSTIG_YAEGER_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2023, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.02910765415, pl_radj 0.08841125, pl_bmassj 0.00296

quotes.title: LHS 475 b
quotes.card: LHS 475 b is a terrestrial exoplanet orbiting the star LHS 475 which is about 40.7 light years away, in the constellation of Octans.
quotes.introduction: It was the first extrasolar planet to be confirmed by the James Webb Space Telescope.
